create_BarkourClient: create a BarkourClient instance to interface with an MJPC binary running the Barkour task
get_BarkourClient_state: get the current BarkourState including torso and foot positions and velocities from the MJPC simulation
reset_BarkourClient: reset the BarkourClient simulation and reinitialize reward weights and task parameters
build_BarkourState_dataclass: build a BarkourState dataclass containing torso and foot position and velocity arrays for the quadruped robot
review_BarkourClient_reset_reward: review the BarkourClient._reset_reward method that loads default task parameters and cost weights
